name: Shelyn's Grace

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

text:
You call upon Shelyn to manifest a tiny mote of her power through one of the three statues. The exact effects vary, depending on the statue you choose to activate, but regardless, Shelyn's Grace may be activated only once every 24 hours, and the specific effects have a counteract of 11th rank and a +17 modifier for any rolls made to counteract conditions.

Dancing Shelyn: Shelyn's Grace casts a 6th-rank Sure Footing on all creatures in the room. For the next 8 hours, all creatures in area C45 gain a +1 item bonus to Performance checks during daylight hours.

Contemplative Shelyn: Shelyn's Grace casts a 6th-rank Clear Mind on all creatures in the room. For the next 8 hours, all creatures in area C45 gain a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks during daylight hours.

Sleeping Shelyn: Shelyn's Grace casts a 6th-rank Sound Body on all creatures in the room. For the next 8 hours, all creatures in area C45 gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks during daylight hours.
